records.translation: Madilim na Kamisetang may Matingkad na Detalye

records.source: A dark shirt with bright highlights.
records.translation: Isang madilim na kamisetang may mga matingkad na detalye.
Kamisetang Omni
May mumunting batik ito sa mga kulay ng bahaghari!
Kamisetang Pangkasal

records.source: A beautiful white top, perfect for a bride.
records.translation: Isang magandang puting pang-itaas, perpekto para sa isang nobya.
Kayumangging Oberol

records.source: It's hard to see the dirt stains on this one.
records.translation: Hindi gaanong halata rito ang mga mantsa ng lupa.
Kahel na Kamisetang may Laso

records.source: A striped orange shirt with a big white bow.
records.translation: Isang kahel na kamisetang may guhit at malaking puting laso.
Puting Oberol

records.source: A nice clean variant of the classic farmer look.
records.translation: Isang malinis at magandang bersiyon ng klasikong ayos ng magsasaka.
Kamisetang Kapeng Buhos

records.source: A familiar zig-zag pattern adorns this shirt. Ahhh... that smell.
records.translation: Pinalamutian ang kamisetang ito ng pamilyar na disenyong zigzag. Ahhh... ang samyo.
Kamisetang may Berdeng Dyaket

records.source: Inspired by the mallard's coat. The shirt can be dyed.
records.translation: Hango sa balahibo ng barakong pato. Maaaring kulayan ang kamiseta.
Maikling Dyaket

records.source: A short dyeable jacket over a shirt.
records.translation: Isang maikling dyaket sa ibabaw ng kamiseta; maaari itong kulayan.
Kamisetang Tuldok-Tuldok

records.source: A dark shirt with dyeable polka dots.
records.translation: Isang madilim na kamisetang may mga tuldok na maaaring kulayan.
Kamisetang may Puting Tuldok

records.source: A dyeable shirt with white polka dots.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang maaaring kulayan at may mga puting tuldok.
Kamisetang Kamuflahe

records.source: Helps you blend in with the surroundings.
records.translation: Tinutulungan ka nitong hindi mahalata sa paligid.
Kamisetang Lupa

records.source: You'll fit right in on the farm!
records.translation: Bagay na bagay ka sa bukid!
Kamisetang Keyk ng Alimango

records.source: Pre-slathered with aioli for your enjoyment. Bon Appetit!
records.translation: Makapal na itong pinahiran ng aioli para masiyahan ka. Kain nang mabuti!
Malasutlang Kamiseta

records.source: It's made from a smooth silky substance.
records.translation: Yari ito sa makinis at malasutlang materyal.
Asul na Tsalekong de-Butones

records.source: It's a blue shirt with dyeable sleeves.
records.translation: Isang asul na kamisetang maaaring kulayan ang mga manggas.
Kupas na Kamisetang Denim

records.source: It's a denim shirt with a dusty, faded look.
records.translation: Isang kamisetang denim na maalikabok at kupas ang anyo.
Pulang Tsalekong de-Butones

records.source: It's a red shirt with dyeable sleeves.
records.translation: Isang pulang kamisetang maaaring kulayan ang mga manggas.
Berdeng Tsalekong de-Butones

records.source: It's a green shirt with dyeable sleeves.
records.translation: Isang berdeng kamisetang maaaring kulayan ang mga manggas.
Kamisetang Kamatis

records.source: A shirt that answers the big question: 'Tomatoes are'... (but the rest is smudged).
records.translation: Isang kamisetang sumasagot sa malaking tanong: 'Ang mga kamatis ay'... (ngunit nabura ang natitira).
